why: Source: project two rows 20 years forward and compare, compare past growth against the rest of the market, compare past and forward growth rates, compute a past share against 10% (about 7 steps); question: the same four statements tested the same way on a table of the same shape (about 7 steps).

Source: read four years of revenue off gridlines on a dual-axis chart, read four headcounts off a second chart, divide, average or approximate (4 steps); question: the same gridline readings across two charts, division and average for the seating segment (4 steps).

Source: pick five labelled values from each of two bar charts, five ratios, rank with one close call (about 3 steps); question: the same five ratios from two labelled bar charts and a ranking with one close call (about 3 steps).

Source: locate the country row, daily profit, annualise, divide cost by annual profit, round up to the first option reached (5 steps); question: locate the region row, daily profit, annualise, divide, round up (5 steps).

Source: compute baseline and peak minutes per unit, then for four options read the step chart for staff needed and compute minutes per unit, spotting the threshold crossing (about 7 steps); question: the identical structure with a step chart, four options and a 300-frame threshold crossing (about 7 steps).

Source: read the price to restaurant from the waterfall, take 10% of it, divide by the preparation cost (3 steps); question: read the price to outlet, take 10%, divide by the peeling and cutting cost (3 steps).

Source: chain four funnel percentages to get paying clients, saving per property, halve it, multiply (4 steps); question: chain four percentages to get paying farms, water bill saving per farm, halve it, multiply (4 steps).

Source: pick the final sorted stage, take the complement for each period, multiply by each period's volume, subtract (4 steps, with the trap of using an earlier stage); question: the same complement, two volume products and a difference with the same stage trap (4 steps).

Source: total each series and the overall sum, then test four share statements against thresholds (about 5 steps); question: the same three totals and four threshold checks on a stacked bar of the same kind (about 5 steps).

Source: read margins off gridlines, compute four years of profit for one category against the other three combined, plus growth, share and margin-decline checks for the other statements (about 6 steps); question: the same gridline reading, profit comparison and three elimination checks (about 6 steps).
